summary: I18N-STABILIZATION-P0 — VALIDAZIONE METODOLOGICA DEFINITIVA. Full CHAIN-01 through CHAIN-06 executed. PREREQUISITE DISCREPANCY: DB initial state was NOT it-IT+en-US+es-MX as required — actual DB had es-ES (not es-MX) as 3rd blueprint language. State was corrected manually (disabled es-ES, enabled es-MX, then confirmed 3-lang state). After correct setup, ALL 6 CHAIN tests PASS. Dynamic chain confirmed: enable es-MX → appears in switcher; disable es-MX → disappears. STALE CACHE NOTE: without clearing mfd_language_registry_db_cache_v1, old state may persist until bootstrapLanguagesFromDB runs on load.

issues: React warning 'Cannot update a component while rendering a different component' — LocalizationOverlay triggering setState inside Sidebar/Section/LoginPage render. Pre-existing known issue.

prerequisite_discrepancy.note: DB initial state WAS NOT as specified. Required: [it-IT, en-US, es-MX]. Actual found: [it-IT, en-US, es-ES]. es-MX had blueprint_enabled=false. es-ES had blueprint_enabled=true. Test was conducted after correcting state: disabled es-ES, enabled es-MX via PATCH API.

CHAIN-01.note: After clearing stale localStorage cache and correct DB setup

CHAIN-03.detail: es-MX persists after page reload. LocaleSwitcher still shows 3 options: [it-IT, en-US, es-MX]

CHAIN-04.action: PATCH /api/platform/admin/languages/es-MX {blueprint_enabled: false} via curl (Playwright PATCH timed out due to Cloudflare)
CHAIN-04.detail: LocaleSwitcher shows ONLY 2 options after disable + reload. es-MX removed.

CHAIN-05.detail: Final invariant confirmed: LocaleSwitcher === DB blueprint_enabled=true === ['it-IT','en-US']

CHAIN-06.detail: localStorage.mfd_language_registry_override = null in ALL test steps. Override key never created.

initial_db_discrepancy.issue: DB had es-ES (blueprint_enabled=true) not es-MX as initial state
initial_db_discrepancy.cause: Likely leftover from previous test iterations where es-ES was set instead of es-MX
initial_db_discrepancy.mitigation: Corrected manually: PATCH es-ES blueprint_enabled=false, PATCH es-MX blueprint_enabled=true

stale_cache_bug.issue: When loaded with stale mfd_language_registry_db_cache_v1 (from prev session showing es-ES), LocaleSwitcher initially showed es-ES instead of es-MX even though DB had es-MX
stale_cache_bug.cause: bootstrapLanguagesFromDB() is async — first render uses localStorage cache. If cache is stale (from different DB state), switcher shows stale data until bootstrap completes
stale_cache_bug.severity: MEDIUM — causes brief flash of wrong locale options on first load
stale_cache_bug.mitigation: Cache auto-refreshes after bootstrapLanguagesFromDB() resolves and dispatches mfd:languages:change event. Full page reload shows correct data.

dynamic_chain_summary.db_as_source_of_truth: CONFIRMED — LocaleSwitcher mirrors DB blueprint_enabled=true state exactly after reload

action_items: SETUP: E1 must ensure DB initial state is correctly set to [it-IT, en-US, es-MX] before each test run. Currently DB had es-ES instead of es-MX.
MEDIUM: Stale localStorage cache (mfd_language_registry_db_cache_v1) can cause LocaleSwitcher to show old language list on first render. Consider invalidating cache when DB is known to have changed.
MINOR: Fix React setState-during-render anti-pattern in LocalizationOverlay (pre-existing).
critical_code_review_comments: blueprintLanguages() correctly filters DB mirror by blueprint_enabled=true — working as designed
isBlueprintOperational() whitelist includes both es-ES and es-MX — correct, supports both Spanish variants
mfd:languages:change event dispatch from bootstrapLanguagesFromDB() correctly triggers BlueprintContext to refresh availableLocales

CACHE STALENESS: bootstrapLanguagesFromDB uses scope=all which fetches ALL languages. The cache accurately reflects the full DB state including blueprint_enabled flags. If DB state changed externally, stale cache will be shown until next bootstrap call.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (6/6 CHAIN tests PASS after correct DB setup)

seed_data_creation: Corrected DB state: disabled es-ES blueprint_enabled, enabled es-MX blueprint_enabled. After CHAIN-04, DB left with [it-IT, en-US] as blueprint languages (es-MX disabled, es-ES disabled).
context_for_next_testing_agent: CHAIN tests validated. DB left in state: it-IT blueprint=true, en-US blueprint=true, es-MX blueprint=false, es-ES blueprint=false. Dynamic chain WORKS: enable language → appears in LocaleSwitcher after reload; disable → disappears. Key finding: Playwright PATCH requests to admin API timeout (Cloudflare), use curl for PATCH calls. Stale localStorage cache (mfd_language_registry_db_cache_v1) can cause initial mismatch — clear it for clean test runs.
